title: A dissociation between moral judgments and justifications
central_claims: Moral permissibility judgments follow the double-effect distinction across trolley scenarios despite frequent inability to articulate matching justifications.

source_manifest.title: Many Labs2: Investigating Variation in Replicability Across Samples and Settings
source_manifest.finding: Both double-effect contrasts survived: switch/push d=1.35 and Ned/Oscar d=.25. Prior familiarity weakened the first effect but did not eliminate it. This does not separately retest inability to justify judgments.
